capabilities: preview Word documents with styles, tables, images, headers and footers
preview PowerPoint slides with shapes, pictures, tables and charts
preview Excel sheets with values and formula results
configure slide fit-width and sheet row/column limits in settings
disambiguation: Read-only preview only; it does not edit or create Office documents.
extras: Desktop only; the rendering engine relies on Node.js and Obsidian Mobile is not supported. Not yet listed in the community plugin directory (manual installation from Releases); the manifest notes it has not been reviewed by Obsidian staff. Licensed Apache-2.0.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to open Office-format attachments, so users must switch to Word, PowerPoint, Excel or another external app to view them.
summary: Attachment viewer that previews Word (.docx), PowerPoint (.pptx) and Excel (.xlsx) files inside Obsidian, fully local and read-only.
